utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can be there around 10 and help on the porch. Do you want me to start by greeting people or sorting the tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Come by at 10 and start greeting people at the porch; once the tools come in, we can shift you to sorting them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I can spread the word and ask about a table too, but I’ll need to know if there’s any space set aside for parking and tool drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, we can set aside a spot for parking and tool drop-off by the front porch. I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still trying to get a few more helpers lined up for Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone who can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli. I’m still trying to line up a few more helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate it, and I’ll send the time and a quick list of what we need so you can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can come by around 10 on Saturday. Do you want me on the front porch helping with greetings, tools, or sorting parts?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina. If you can, help with greetings and sorting tools on the porch, and I’ll keep an eye on where people can set things down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I can help out Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll ask around for anyone else handy.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That would be great, thanks. I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Come by around 10 a.m. on the front porch, and I could use help greeting folks, setting out tools, and keeping the parts sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa. I can help greet folks and keep the parts sorted around 10 a.m.
